# You Are An Idiot

> A recreation of the classic "You Are An Idiot" web experience, originally found at youdontknowwhoiam.org — a retro Windows 95-style animated meme page with flashing windows and the original chant.

Author: Vojtik Vokoun
Language: English
URL: https://youare.qzz.io/

## What the site is

"You Are An Idiot" is a faithful recreation of the early-2000s internet meme
site originally hosted at youdontknowwhoiam.org. The original page played a
looping animation of smiling faces while chanting "you are an idiot", and
attempted to trap the visitor by spawning endless pop-up windows whenever
they tried to leave. This recreation rebuilds that experience with modern,
safe techniques: it is styled like a genuine Windows 95 desktop using the
98.css library, sits on the signature teal (#008080) background, and uses a
real browser pop-up window for the main experience instead of trapping the
visitor.

## How a visit works

1. The visitor lands on the entry page (/). It automatically opens a small
   test pop-up (test.html) several times to detect whether the browser
   allows pop-up windows for the site.
2. A Windows 95-style dialog (built with 98.css) reports the result:
   - If pop-ups are blocked, the dialog explains that pop-ups must be
     allowed, and offers to retry the test. Enter triggers the default
     button, Escape closes the dialog.
   - If pop-ups are allowed, the dialog asks "Are You Sure?" before
     starting the experience.
3. On confirmation, the site opens the main experience in a real pop-up
   window (popup.html).

## Pages

- [You Are An Idiot](https://youare.qzz.io/): Entry page. Runs the pop-up
  permission test, shows retro dialog boxes, and launches the experience.
- [Are You An Idiot? pop-up](https://youare.qzz.io/popup.html): The main
  experience — a 98.css "Are You An Idiot?" dialog with the classic
  animation, sound, and window behavior.
- [Test pop-up](https://youare.qzz.io/test.html): Helper page used only by
  the pop-up permission check; not part of the main experience.

## Technical notes

- Pure static HTML/CSS/JS; no frameworks, no build step.
- Window chrome (title bars, buttons, bevels, fonts) comes from the 98.css
  library, loaded from unpkg.com.
- Dialogs support keyboard interaction: Enter activates the default button
  ("OK" / "Yes") and Escape closes them.
- Audio (/media/test.mp3) starts muted to satisfy browser autoplay rules and
  unmutes after a user interaction.
- Because the experience depends on real pop-up windows, visitors must allow
  pop-ups for the site; the entry page detects this and guides them through
  it.

## Credits

Recreated by Vojtik Vokoun as a nostalgia project. The original meme dates
from the early 2000s (youdontknowwhoiam.org).
